content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: A journal inverse is where the recording leg meets D8b's whole-operation markers, S3-revert's write half, D8a's per-kind inverse and D2's ownership. The criterion checks that the journal entry is the recording's inverse without contradicting any of them.
